question: How many strobe lights are there, and where?

options.text: Two, one on each wing tip
Four, on the wing tips and fuselage top and bottom
Three: one on each wing tip and one below the tail cone

explanation: The three strobes flash in synchronisation.

question: With the STROBE switch in AUTO, when do the strobes come on?

options.text: When the main gear strut is not compressed
When the landing lights are on

explanation: AUTO turns them on once airborne; crews usually select ON just before the take-off roll.
reference: Study use only. Verify against the FCOM of your operator and aircraft before relying on it.

question: What does the red flashing beacon signal to the ground crew?
